description: This is a shell script used for deploying the prplMesh software package (.ipk) to a target device via SSH. It handles copying the package, cleaning previous installations, and optionally enabling certification mode on the target device.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Performs the deployment of the IPK package to the target device, including copying files, cleaning previous installations, and optionally enabling certification mode.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses command-line options and initiates deployment.
